title: Seoul K-drama filming locations: 15 spots to visit
desc: K-drama filming locations around Seoul, from hanok villages and palaces to Han River parks, each with the shows filmed there.

items.title: Bukchon Hanok Village
items.memo: Hanok alleys seen in Personal Taste, Love Next Door and Our Beloved Summer.

items.title: Ikseon-dong Hanok Village
items.memo: Hanok-lined lanes from True Beauty and Love Scout; busy on weekends, go early.

items.title: Dongdaemun Design Plaza (DDP)
items.memo: Futuristic landmark seen in the Vincenzo finale and Lovely Runner.

items.title: Gwanghwamun Square
items.memo: Central square featured in The King: Eternal Monarch and Love Scout.

items.title: Deoksugung Stone-wall Road
items.memo: Stone-wall walk from Doctor Slump and Extraordinary Attorney Woo; lovely at night.

items.title: Namsan Baekbeom Square
items.memo: Namsan square seen in Love Alarm and Itaewon Class.

items.title: N Seoul Tower
items.memo: Iconic tower from Business Proposal, King the Land, Boys Over Flowers and more.

items.title: Naksan Park
items.memo: Hilltop park on the old city wall, seen in Itaewon Class and Call It Love.

items.title: Ihwa Mural Village
items.memo: Mural village from Strong Woman Do Bong Soon and Love Next Door; residential, keep quiet.

items.title: Yeouido Hangang Park
items.memo: Riverside park from Start-Up and Legend of the Blue Sea; fireworks festival in autumn.

items.title: Banpo Bridge & Hangang Park
items.memo: Riverside scenes from Our Unwritten Seoul and Itaewon Class; rainbow fountain at night.

items.title: Nodeul Island
items.memo: Han River island used as Start-Up's SANDBOX campus.

items.title: Oil Tank Culture Park
items.memo: Former oil depot turned culture park, used as Start-Up's SANDBOX entrance.

items.title: Common Ground
items.memo: Container mall seen in Vincenzo and Our Unwritten Seoul.

items.title: Gyeongui Line Forest Park
items.memo: Linear park on an old rail line, seen in Because This Is My First Life and I Am Not a Robot.
